title: Kyu mujhko akela chord chale
body:
KYUN MUJHKO AKELA CHHOD CHALE
Batlao mujhe Qasim Dulha, Kyun mujhko akela chhod chale
Dil tham ke yuin Kubra ne kaha, kyun mujhko akela chhod chale
Moo modke tumko jaana tha, gar chhodke mujhko jaana tha
<<DIVIDER>>
Kyu haath mera thama tha bhala, Kyun mujhko akela chhod chale
Raas aayi na bachpan ki shaadi, dekho to meri ye barbadi
Kis jurm ki payi maine saza, Kyun mujhko akela chhod chale
Shadi thi meri kya khoob rachi, sab mujhko dulhan kehte the abhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Aur kehte hai ab mujhko bewa, Kyun mujhko akela chhod chale
Chup kis liye ho bolo Qasim, baazu se rasan kholo Qasim
Hoti hai bohot mujhko eiza, Kyun mujhko akela chhod chale
Ab kaun kare imdad meri, ab kaun sune faryad meri
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi bhi nahi sunne wala, Kyun mujhko akela chhod chale
Qaime mein qayamat thi barpa, pamaal huwa jis dum laasha
Mat poocho mera kya haal huwa, Kyun mujhko akela chhod chale
Manzar tha qayamat ka wo Nazar, phat-ta tha har ek ka gham se jigar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ro roke jo kehti thi kubra, Kyun mujhko akela chhod chale
